definitions.explanation: A flat stone set in a garden path or across water at intervals, so that one can cross by stepping from one stone to the next. A characteristic feature of Japanese gardens.

examples.japanese: {飛|と}び{石|いし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}って→渡る：02441_wataru⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: You cross the garden by walking on the stepping stones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{池|いけ}→池：00848_ike⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んだ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧{飛|と}び{石|いし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つずつ→一つずつ：24348_hitotsuzutsu⟧⟦{渡|わた}った→渡る：02441_wataru⟧。
examples.english: I crossed the stepping stones set across the pond one by one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本庭園|にほんていえん}→日本庭園：19199_nihonteien⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{飛|と}び{石|いし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{景観|けいかん}→景観：12976_keikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧になっている。
examples.english: In a Japanese garden, the stepping stones are part of the scenery.

notes:
Flat stones laid at intervals so one can cross a garden or stream step by step.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飛|と}び{石|いし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧: to cross on stepping stones
- {飛|と}び{石|いし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to lay stepping stones

RELATED WORDS:
- {飛|と}び{石|いし}{連休|れんきゅう}: a run of holidays broken up by workdays (e.g., days off on Monday and Wednesday but not Tuesday) — from the image of scattered stepping stones
